memory_update.text: CRWV should be retained as the high-attention reference benchmark for public neocloud economics, not as an underfollowed discovery candidate.
IREN is a large-cap but unusually pure AI-cloud transition candidate; later layers must stress-test NVIDIA/Microsoft contract economics, capex, GPU financing, and utilization.
APLD is a second-order AI capacity landlord candidate; later layers should verify CoreWeave lease commencement, project financing, power availability, and tenant concentration.
CIFR fits the preferred under-USD-10B underfollowed lane; its key survival tests are Fluidstack counterparty quality, 168MW delivery by September 2026, capex funding, and power economics.
Need a follow-up pass on BTDR, HUT, WULF, CORZ/Core Scientific status, and other crypto-to-AI infrastructure conversions to avoid missing smaller power-capacity owners.

node: Specialized AI cloud capacity and GPU-as-a-service infrastructure
summary: Expanded the universe around specialized AI cloud capacity using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: CoreWeave as the high-attention public neocloud anchor. Discovery lane: IREN, Applied Digital, and Cipher Digital/Cipher Mining as public second-order capacity owners or GPU/HPC infrastructure providers. The node appears investable through both direct GPU-cloud operators and power/data-center landlords, but all non-reference names carry financing, construction, utilization, customer-concentration, and depreciation risk. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
